description: An ultra-light MacOS utility that helps hide menu bar icons

latest_release.name: v1.13.3: hidden icons stay hidden, arrow notes, notification banner fix
latest_release.body:
### Added
- Direct build on macOS 27: when a click on the arrow or the hotkey hides nothing, a short note under the arrow says why and what to do (running outside Applications, an icon macOS cannot keep visible while the pause switch is on, Accessibility missing, or every icon sitting right of the arrow). It shows once per reason per launch, never for auto-hide.
### Fixed
- macOS 26: auto-hide no longer waits on a notification banner. A banner puts up the same screen-tall Notification Center window as the panel, and the 26 check took any such window for the open panel, so a run of notifications held auto-hide for as long as they lasted (up to 10 minutes after the last one). Without Accessibility, which macOS 26 does not need for hiding, the window alone is no longer taken for the panel; with it, only the panel's Edit Widgets control counts ([#579](https://github.com/dwarvesf/hidden/issues/579)).
- macOS 27 (direct build): when macOS refuses the updated hide list after an app starts, the icons that were hidden stay hidden. The bar used to show every hidden icon with a collapsed arrow and no auto-hide until you clicked the arrow; now it either stays collapsed or shows the expanded arrow and auto-hide retries.

detail.readme:
## Hidden Bar Hidden Bar lets you hide menu bar items to give your Mac a cleaner look.

## 🚀 Install > **Official downloads.** Console Labs publishes Hidden Bar only through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases), the Homebrew cask `hiddenbar`, and the [Mac App Store listing](https://itunes.apple.com/app/hidden-bar/id1452453066). Any other site offering Hidden Bar (for example `hiddenbar.app`) is not run by Console Labs. ###  App Store [![AppStore](img/appstore.svg)](https://itunes.apple.com/app/hidden-bar/id1452453066) The App Store build is sandboxed and cannot hide icons on macOS 27. On macOS 27, use the GitHub or Homebrew build below. ### Others The Hidden Bar is notarized before distributed out side App Store. It's safe to use 👍 #### Using Homebrew ``` brew install --cask hiddenbar ``` Coming from the App Store version? Quit it and move `/Applications/Hidden Bar.app` to the Trash first: Homebrew does not install over it. Your settings stay; the new version offers to import them on first launch. #### Manual download - [Download latest version](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases/latest) - Open and drag the app to the Applications folder. - Launch Hidden and drag the icon in your menu bar (hold CMD) to the right so it is between some other icons. ## 🕹 Usage * `⌘` + drag to move the Hidden icons around in the menu bar. * Click the Arrow icon to hide menu bar items, and click it again to show them. * Option-click the Arrow to reach the always-hidden section, a second group that stays hidden when you click the arrow. * Settings has the hide delay, a global shortcut, other ways to reveal icons (hover, scroll, shake) and the arrow style.

## 📚 Documentation - [Manual](docs/MANUAL.md): every setting, the hidden Terminal-only options, and troubleshooting. - [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the hiding trick works, topology, and known limits. - [Maintainer runbook](docs/RUNBOOK.md): build, behavioral verification, and release process. ## ✨Contributors This project exists thanks to all the people who contribute. Thank you guys so much 👏 [![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/0)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/0)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/1)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/1)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/2)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/2)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/3)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/3)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/4)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/4)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/5)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/5)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/6)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/6)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/7)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/7) Please read [this](CONTRIBUTING.md) before you make a contribution. ## Requirements macOS version >= 13.0 (Ventura) Running an older macOS? The last release supporting macOS 10.13 High Sierra through 12 Monterey is [v1.10](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases/tag/v1.10).
